note: Typical recogniser mishearings of the station's words, variant -> canonical (extra_dict.py documents the format and the contexts). Evidence: n counts stored voice clips (sent transcripts) that carry the variant in the entry's context; source owner = named by the owner, verdict = an owner verdict in clip_truth, observed = stored transcripts without a verdict. An owner-named variant may have n = 0. A variant the grammar's lexicon.wake already holds («Толиса», «Тариса», «Малис», «Лисы» were all seen in the stored clips) is not repeated here: the loader refuses it.
